beats.text: Why keep going when it hurts?
Nietzsche gave an answer that outlived him.
A person with a strong enough 'why' can bear almost any 'how.'
Pain, on its own, rarely breaks people. Meaningless pain does.
Find the why — someone you love, a thing you're building, a reason — and the suffering becomes survivable.
Lose it, and even comfort starts to rot.
So build the why first. The how takes care of itself.

attribution: Friedrich Nietzsche · Twilight of the Idols
source_note: Paraphrased from Nietzsche (Twilight of the Idols, 1888) — wording varies by translation.
